scope: Bundled primary editions: source wording that requires language-specific study-note adaptation. Exact snippets are evidence, not edits to Scripture.

records.native_phrase: ثُمَّ هَاجَرَ إِلَى أَشُّورَ وَبَنَى نِينَوَى وَرَحُوبُوتَ عَيْرَ وَكَالَحَ،
records.english_gloss: The continuing subject is Nimrod; the verse describes going or expansion into Assyria and building cities.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Nimrod as the displayed subject and Asshur as the alternative reading; do not claim this base edition names Asshur as the builder.

records.native_phrase: لَا يُحْسَبْ مِنْ ضِمْنِ جَمَاعَةِ اللهِ ابْنُ زِنًا، وَلَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ نَسْلِهِ، وَلَوْ فِي الْجِيلِ الْعَاشِرِ.
records.english_gloss: a child born of illicit sex
records.note_adaptation: Describe the actual native birth-status term without turning it into the child personally committing the parents' sin.

records.native_phrase: ’هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَصِيرَ الْإِنْسَانُ صَالِحًا فِي نَظَرِ اللهِ؟ أَوْ يَصِيرَ الْمَخْلُوقُ طَاهِرًا فِي نَظَرِ خَالِقِهِ.
records.english_gloss: Can a mortal be righteous or pure before/in the sight of God?
records.note_adaptation: Change both summary and the this-translation sentence to the before-God question; do not import the English more-than comparison.

records.native_phrase: لِذَلِكَ يُعْطِيكُمُ اللهُ نَفْسُهُ آيَةً: الْعَذْرَاءُ تَحْبَلُ، وَتَلِدُ ابْنًا، وَتُسَمِّيهِ عَمَّانُوئِيلَ.
records.english_gloss: The virgin/maiden will conceive or bear a son.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the native virgin/maiden term here and the young-woman comparison with other versions.

records.native_phrase: يَقُلْنَ: ”أَعْطُونَا نَصِيحَةً، قَدِّمُوا لَنَا مَشُورَةً، اِجْعَلُوا ظِلَّكُمْ يَحْمِينَا فِي الظُّهْرِ، كَمَا لَوْ كَانَ لَيْلًا. خَبِّئُوا الْمَنْفِيِّينَ، لَا تَخُونُوا اللَّاجِئِينَ. | أَضِيفُوا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَنْفِيِّينَ مِنْ مُوآبَ، كُونُوا مَلْجَأً لَهُمْ مِنَ الْمُهْلِكِ.“ سَتَأْتِي نِهَايَةُ الظَّالِمِ، وَيَنْتَهِي الْخَرَابُ، وَيَفْنَى
records.english_gloss: The appeal asks for Moabite fugitives to be received and protected.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Moabite refugees as those receiving refuge; do not reverse the request into a duty assigned to Moab to host others.

records.native_phrase: فَقَاسَ الْجَانِبَ الشَّرْقِيَّ بِعَصَا الْقِيَاسِ، فَكَانَ حَوَالَيْ 250 مِتْرًا.
records.english_gloss: Each side measures approximately 250 metres.
records.note_adaptation: Use 250 metres in summary and the this-translation sentence. Explain that other editions give five hundred cubits or reeds/rods. Native 40:5 gives the measuring rod as about three metres; do not quote six long cubits as its displayed wording.

records.native_phrase: وَقَالَ اللهُ لِي: ”اِذْهَبْ وَأَحْبِبْ زَوْجَتَكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، مَعَ أَنَّهَا خَائِنَةٌ وَتَعْشَقُ وَاحِدًا آخَرَ. أَحْبِبْهَا كَمَا يُحِبُّ اللهُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مَعَ أَنَّهُمْ مُنْحَرِفُونَ إِلَى آلِهَةٍ أُخْرَى وَيُحِبُّونَ أَقْرَاصَ الزَّبِيبِ.“
records.english_gloss: Love your wife again / bring your wife back.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the statement that this edition calls her his wife, while explaining that Gomer is not named in chapter 3.
records.payment_verse_3_2: فَاشْتَرَيْتُهَا لِي بِـ15 عُمْلَةً مِنَ الْفِضَّةِ وَ30 كَيْلَةً مِنَ الشَّعِيرِ، (3:2).
records.payment_adaptation: Portuguese includes fifteen silver pieces, a large barrel of barley and a wineskin. Simplified Chinese gives three liang silver and200kg barley. Japanese gives15shekels(171g),1.5homers(330L), and explicitly calls her the enslaved wife. Distinguish these displayed words from the Hebrew fifteen shekels and homer-plus-lethech of barley; do not silently impose the English wording.

records.native_phrase: وَقَالَ الْمَوْلَى رَبُّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: ”أَنَا أَكْرَهُ الطَّلَاقَ، وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَظْلِمَ الرَّجُلُ زَوْجَتَهُ وَكَأَنَّهُ يَلْبَسُ ثَوْبَهُ! فَاحْذَرُوا، لَا تَخُونُوا.“ هَذَا كَلَامُ الْمَوْلَى الْقَدِيرِ.
records.english_gloss: God says He hates divorce/putting away a wife.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the divine-hatred reading as this edition's wording and the man-who-hates-and-divorces reading as the comparison.

records.native_phrase: وَنَصَبَ بَنُو دَانَ لِنَفْسِهِمِ الصَّنَمَ الْمَنْحُوتَ. وَكَانَ يُونَاثَانُ ابْنُ جَرْشُومَ ابْنِ مَنَسَّى، هُوَ وَبَنُوهُ كَهَنَةً لِقَبِيلَةِ دَانَ إِلَى يَوْمِ خَرَجَ أَهْلُ الْبِلَادِ فِي الْأَسْرِ.
records.english_gloss: Jonathan son of Gershom, son of Manasseh.
records.note_adaptation: Identify Manasseh as the displayed reading and Moses as the alternative; do not silently relabel this edition's genealogy as Moses.

records.native_phrase: فَخَانَتْهُ جَارِيَتُهُ، وَخَرَجَتْ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ وَرَجَعَتْ إِلَى دَارِ أَبِيهَا فِي بَيْتَ لَحْمَ فِي يَهُوذَا، وَأَقَامَتْ هُنَاكَ 4 أَشْهُرٍ.
records.english_gloss: She was unfaithful to him / committed adultery and left.
records.note_adaptation: The displayed edition uses unfaithfulness/adultery; preserve the existence of the angry alternative without declaring either universal.

additional_findings.native_phrase: فَقَالَ لَهَا: ”قُومِي نَذْهَبُ.“ فَلَمْ تَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ. فَأَخَذَهَا عَلَى الْحِمَارِ، وَمَضَى وَرَجَعَ إِلَى دَارِهِ.
additional_findings.english_gloss: She gives no response; he puts her on the donkey and goes home.
additional_findings.note_adaptation: Do not add an explicit dead/corpse statement as this verse's wording; keep the exact death time unstated and distinguish the later report in20:5.

records.native_phrase: وَالْآنَ أَنَا ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى الْقُدْسِ بِدَافِعٍ مِنَ الرُّوحِ. وَلَا أَعْلَمُ مَاذَا يَنْتَظِرُنِي هُنَاكَ.
records.english_gloss: Driven/bound/compelled by the Spirit, I go to Jerusalem; the next verse names the Holy Spirit's warnings.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the native Spirit-agency wording, with explicit Holy Spirit attribution for the warnings in 20:23; do not replace it with merely personal determination.

records.native_phrase: Von diesem Land zog er aus nach Assur und baute Ninive, Rechobot-Ir und Kelach,
records.english_gloss: The continuing subject is Nimrod; the verse describes going or expansion into Assyria and building cities.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Nimrod as the displayed subject and Asshur as the alternative reading; do not claim this base edition names Asshur as the builder.

records.native_phrase: Es soll auch kein Bastard in die Gemeinde des Herrn kommen; auch die zehnte Generation seiner Nachkommen soll nicht in die Gemeinde des Herrn kommen.
records.english_gloss: a bastard / illegitimate child
records.note_adaptation: Describe the actual native birth-status term without turning it into the child personally committing the parents' sin. The birth-status rule is native 23:3; native 23:2 is the bodily-injury rule.

records.native_phrase: Kann wohl ein Sterblicher gerecht sein vor Gott, oder ein Mann rein vor seinem Schöpfer?
records.english_gloss: Can a mortal be righteous or pure before/in the sight of God?
records.note_adaptation: Change both summary and the this-translation sentence to the before-God question; do not import the English more-than comparison.

records.native_phrase: Darum wird euch der Herr selbst ein Zeichen geben: Siehe, die Jungfrau wird schwanger werden und einen Sohn gebären und wird ihm den Namen Immanuel geben.
records.english_gloss: The virgin/maiden will conceive or bear a son.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the native virgin/maiden term here and the young-woman comparison with other versions.

records.native_phrase: Gib Rat, triff eine Entscheidung! Mach deinen Schatten am hellen Mittag gleich der dunklen Nacht, verbirg die Verjagten, verrate die Flüchtlinge nicht! | Lass meine Flüchtlinge bei dir einkehren, Moab; sei ihnen ein Schirm vor dem Verderber! Wenn der Bedrücker nicht mehr da ist, das Zerstören aufgehört hat, die Gewalttätigen von der Erde weggefegt sind,
records.english_gloss: Let my refugees stay with you, Moab; be a shelter for them.
records.note_adaptation: Moab is addressed as the host. Adapt summary and note to an appeal for Moab to shelter the refugees, without inventing their unstated ethnicity.

records.native_phrase: Er maß die Ostseite mit der Messrute: 500 Ruten, nach der Messrute, ringsum.
records.english_gloss: Each side measures five hundred measuring reeds/rods.
records.note_adaptation: Use five hundred reeds/rods in summary and note, with cubits as the alternative. Native 40:5 defines the rod using six extended cubits, so the alternative units imply different sizes.

records.native_phrase: Und der Herr sprach zu mir: Geh nochmals hin und liebe eine Frau, die von ihrem Freund geliebt wird und im Ehebruch lebt, gleichwie der Herr die Kinder Israels liebt, obwohl sie sich anderen Göttern zuwenden und Traubenkuchen lieben!
records.english_gloss: Go again and love a woman / that woman who is loved by another and adulterous.
records.note_adaptation: Replace the claim that this edition explicitly calls her his wife: it says a woman/that woman. Present Gomer as the common identification, not a name stated here.
records.payment_verse_3_2: Da erkaufte ich sie mir um 15 Silberlinge und um ein Homer und ein Letech Gerste. (3:2).
records.payment_adaptation: Portuguese includes fifteen silver pieces, a large barrel of barley and a wineskin. Simplified Chinese gives three liang silver and200kg barley. Japanese gives15shekels(171g),1.5homers(330L), and explicitly calls her the enslaved wife. Distinguish these displayed words from the Hebrew fifteen shekels and homer-plus-lethech of barley; do not silently impose the English wording.

records.native_phrase: Denn ich hasse die Ehescheidung, spricht der Herr, der Gott Israels, und dass man sein Gewand mit Frevel bedeckt, spricht der Herr der Heerscharen; darum hütet euch in eurem Geist und werdet nicht untreu!
records.english_gloss: God says He hates divorce/putting away a wife.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the divine-hatred reading as this edition's wording and the man-who-hates-and-divorces reading as the comparison.

records.native_phrase: Und die Söhne Dans richteten für sich das Bildnis auf. Und Jonathan, der Sohn Gersons, des Sohnes Moses, und seine Söhne waren Priester des Stammes Dan bis zu der Zeit, als das Land in die Gefangenschaft geführt wurde.
records.english_gloss: Jonathan son of Gershom, son/grandson of Moses.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Moses as the displayed reading, with Manasseh explained as the textual alternative.

records.native_phrase: Diese Nebenfrau aber beging Hurerei gegen ihn und lief von ihm fort in das Haus ihres Vaters, nach Bethlehem-Juda, und blieb dort volle vier Monate lang.
records.english_gloss: She was unfaithful to him / committed adultery and left.
records.note_adaptation: The displayed edition uses unfaithfulness/adultery; preserve the existence of the angry alternative without declaring either universal.

additional_findings.native_phrase: Er aber sprach zu ihr: Steh auf, wir wollen gehen! Aber da war keine Antwort. Da nahm er sie auf den Esel, machte sich auf und zog an seinen Ort.
additional_findings.english_gloss: She gives no response; he puts her on the donkey and goes home.
additional_findings.note_adaptation: Do not add an explicit dead/corpse statement as this verse's wording; keep the exact death time unstated and distinguish the later report in20:5.

records.native_phrase: Und siehe, jetzt reise ich gebunden im Geist nach Jerusalem, ohne zu wissen, was mir dort begegnen wird,
records.english_gloss: Bound in spirit, I go to Jerusalem; the next verse explicitly names the Holy Spirit as warning of bonds and hardship.
records.note_adaptation: Keep the native bound-in-spirit wording in the Acts 20:22 comparison rather than adding an explicit Holy Spirit agent; 20:23 explicitly attributes the warnings to the Holy Spirit.

records.native_phrase: Desde esa región Nimrod salió hacia Asiria, donde construyó las ciudades de Nínive, Rejobot Ir, Cala
records.english_gloss: Nimrod is named explicitly as going to Assyria and building the cities.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Nimrod as the displayed subject and Asshur as the alternative reading; do not claim this base edition names Asshur as the builder.

records.native_phrase: No podrá entrar en la asamblea del Señor quien haya nacido de una unión ilegítima; tampoco podrá hacerlo ninguno de sus descendientes, hasta la décima generación.
records.english_gloss: someone born from an illegitimate union
records.note_adaptation: Describe the actual native birth-status term without turning it into the child personally committing the parents' sin.

records.native_phrase: “¿Puede un simple mortal ser más justo que Dios? ¿Puede ser más puro el hombre que su Creador?
records.english_gloss: Can a mortal be more righteous than God or purer than the Creator?
records.note_adaptation: Retain the comparative more-than question and attribute it to the spirit as reported by Eliphaz.

records.native_phrase: Por eso, el Señor mismo les dará una señal: la virgen concebirá y dará a luz un hijo y lo llamará Emanuel.
records.english_gloss: The virgin/maiden will conceive or bear a son.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the native virgin/maiden term here and the young-woman comparison with other versions.

records.native_phrase: «Danos un consejo; toma una decisión. A plena luz del día, extiende tu sombra como la noche. Esconde a los fugitivos; no traiciones a los refugiados. | Deja que los fugitivos de Moab encuentren en ti un refugio; ¡protégelos del destructor!». Cuando la opresión llegue a su fin y la destrucción se acabe, el agresor desaparecerá de la tierra.
records.english_gloss: The appeal asks for Moabite fugitives to be received and protected.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Moabite refugees as those receiving refuge; do not reverse the request into a duty assigned to Moab to host others.

records.native_phrase: Tomó la vara para medir el lado oriental y este medía quinientos codos.
records.english_gloss: Each side measures five hundred cubits.
records.note_adaptation: Retain five hundred cubits, contrasting reeds/rods in other editions. Native 40:5 supplies the measuring rod's six-cubit length.

records.native_phrase: El Señor me dijo: «Ve y vuelve a amar a tu esposa, aunque sea amante de otro y adúltera. Ámala como ama el Señor a los israelitas, aunque se hayan vuelto a otros dioses y se deleiten con las tortas de pasas consagradas que les ofrecen».
records.english_gloss: Love your wife again / bring your wife back.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the statement that this edition calls her his wife, while explaining that Gomer is not named in chapter 3.
records.payment_verse_3_2: Compré entonces a esa mujer por quince siclos de plata y un jómer y un létec de cebada; (3:2).
records.payment_adaptation: Portuguese includes fifteen silver pieces, a large barrel of barley and a wineskin. Simplified Chinese gives three liang silver and200kg barley. Japanese gives15shekels(171g),1.5homers(330L), and explicitly calls her the enslaved wife. Distinguish these displayed words from the Hebrew fifteen shekels and homer-plus-lethech of barley; do not silently impose the English wording.

records.native_phrase: «El hombre que aborrece y repudia a su esposa —dice el Señor, Dios de Israel— cubre de violencia sus vestiduras», dice el Señor de los Ejércitos. Así que cuídense en su espíritu y no sean infieles.
records.english_gloss: The man who hates and divorces his wife covers his clothing with violence.
records.note_adaptation: The displayed subject is the man who hates and divorces. Reverse the English note's this-translation/other-readings clauses; keep God-hates-divorce as the comparison, not this edition's wording.

records.native_phrase: Allí erigieron para sí la imagen tallada y Jonatán, hijo de Guersón y nieto de Moisés, y sus hijos fueron sacerdotes de la tribu de Dan hasta el tiempo del exilio.
records.english_gloss: Jonathan is explicitly called the grandson of Moses and the son of Gershom.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Moses as the displayed reading, with Manasseh explained as the textual alternative. This edition explicitly renders grandson; describe the broader son/descendant issue as a comparison, not a denial of its chosen wording.

records.native_phrase: Pero ella le fue infiel, lo dejó y regresó a la casa de su padre, en Belén de Judá. Había estado allí cuatro meses
records.english_gloss: She was unfaithful to him / committed adultery and left.
records.note_adaptation: The displayed edition uses unfaithfulness/adultery; preserve the existence of the angry alternative without declaring either universal.

additional_findings.native_phrase: «¡Levántate, vámonos!», le dijo, pero no obtuvo respuesta. Entonces el hombre la puso sobre su asno y partió hacia su casa.
additional_findings.english_gloss: She gives no response; he puts her on the donkey and goes home.
additional_findings.note_adaptation: Do not add an explicit dead/corpse statement as this verse's wording; keep the exact death time unstated and distinguish the later report in20:5.

records.native_phrase: »Y ahora tengan en cuenta que voy a Jerusalén obligado por el Espíritu, sin saber lo que allí me espera.
records.english_gloss: Driven/bound/compelled by the Spirit, I go to Jerusalem; the next verse names the Holy Spirit's warnings.
records.note_adaptation: Retain the native Spirit-agency wording, with explicit Holy Spirit attribution for the warnings in 20:23; do not replace it with merely personal determination.

records.native_phrase: De ce pays-là il sortit vers l'Assyrie ; il bâtit Ninive, la ville de Rehoboth, Kalah
records.english_gloss: The continuing subject is Nimrod; the verse describes going or expansion into Assyria and building cities.
records.note_adaptation: Retain Nimrod as the displayed subject and Asshur as the alternative reading; do not claim this base edition names Asshur as the builder.

records.native_phrase: Un bâtard n'entrera pas dans l'assemblée du Seigneur  ; même sa dixième génération n'entrera pas dans l'assemblée du Seigneur.
records.english_gloss: a bastard / illegitimate child
records.note_adaptation: Describe the actual native birth-status term without turning it into the child personally committing the parents' sin. The birth-status rule is native 23:3; native 23:2 is the bodily-injury rule.

records.native_phrase: Un mortel serait-il plus juste que Dieu ? Un homme serait-il plus pur que celui qui le fait ?
records.english_gloss: Can a mortal be more righteous than God or purer than the Creator?
records.note_adaptation: Retain the comparative more-than question and attribute it to the spirit as reported by Eliphaz.

records.native_phrase: C'est pourquoi le Seigneur lui-même vous donnera un signe : la jeune fille est enceinte, elle mettra au monde un fils et l'appellera du nom d'Immanou-El (« Dieu est avec nous »).
records.english_gloss: The young girl is pregnant and will bear a son.
records.note_adaptation: Say this edition uses young woman/young girl and that other editions use virgin; retain the Ahaz setting and Matthew application.

records.native_phrase: Tiens conseil, prends une décision, étends en plein midi ton ombre comme la nuit, cache les réfugiés, ne trahis pas le fugitif ! | Que mes réfugiés séjournent en immigrés chez toi, Moab ! Sois pour eux une cachette devant celui qui ravage tout ! Car c'est la fin de celui qui pressure ; le ravage s'achève, celui qui piétine disparaît du pays.
records.english_gloss: Let my refugees stay with you, Moab; be a shelter for them.
records.note_adaptation: Moab is addressed as the host. Adapt summary and note to an appeal for Moab to shelter the refugees, without inventing their unstated ethnicity.

records.native_phrase: Il mesura le côté de l'est avec la canne à mesurer : en tout cinq cents cannes, avec la canne à mesurer.
records.english_gloss: Each side measures five hundred measuring reeds/rods.
records.note_adaptation: Use five hundred reeds/rods in summary and note, with cubits as the alternative. Native 40:5 defines the rod using six extended cubits, so the alternative units imply different sizes.

records.native_phrase: Le Seigneur me dit : Va encore, aime une femme aimée d'un compagnon, une femme adultère ; aime-la comme le Seigneur (YHWH) aime les Israélites ! Eux, ils se tournent vers d'autres dieux et ils aiment les gâteaux de raisin !
records.english_gloss: Go again and love a woman / that woman who is loved by another and adulterous.
records.note_adaptation: Replace the claim that this edition explicitly calls her his wife: it says a woman/that woman. Present Gomer as the common identification, not a name stated here.
records.payment_verse_3_2: Je l'achetai pour quinze sicles d'argent, un homer d'orge et un létek d'orge ; (3:2).
records.payment_adaptation: Portuguese includes fifteen silver pieces, a large barrel of barley and a wineskin. Simplified Chinese gives three liang silver and200kg barley. Japanese gives15shekels(171g),1.5homers(330L), and explicitly calls her the enslaved wife. Distinguish these displayed words from the Hebrew fifteen shekels and homer-plus-lethech of barley; do not silently impose the English wording.

records.native_phrase: Car détestable est la répudiation – dit le Seigneur, le Dieu d'Israël – comme celui qui couvre de violence son vêtement – dit le Seigneur (YHWH) des Armées. Vous prendrez donc garde à votre esprit, et vous ne trahirez pas.
records.english_gloss: Repudiation/divorce is detestable, says the LORD, as is covering one's clothing with violence.
records.note_adaptation: Use the displayed impersonal divine assessment that repudiation is detestable; do not present it as a verbatim first-person I hate quotation or as the Spanish man-who-hates subject.

records.native_phrase: Les fils de Dan dressèrent pour eux la statue ; Jonathan, fils de Guershom, fils de Manassé, lui et ses fils, furent prêtres pour la tribu des Danites jusqu'au jour de l'exil.
records.english_gloss: Jonathan son of Gershom, son of Manasseh.
records.note_adaptation: Identify Manasseh as the displayed reading and Moses as the alternative; do not silently relabel this edition's genealogy as Moses.

records.native_phrase: Sa concubine lui fut infidèle, puis elle le quitta pour retourner chez son père, à Beth-Léhem de Juda ; elle y resta pendant quatre mois.
records.english_gloss: She was unfaithful to him / committed adultery and left.
records.note_adaptation: The displayed edition uses unfaithfulness/adultery; preserve the existence of the angry alternative without declaring either universal.

additional_findings.native_phrase: Il lui dit : Lève-toi et allons-nous-en. Mais il n'y eut pas de réponse. Alors le mari la mit sur son âne et s'en alla chez lui.
additional_findings.english_gloss: She gives no response; he puts her on the donkey and goes home.
additional_findings.note_adaptation: Do not add an explicit dead/corpse statement as this verse's wording; keep the exact death time unstated and distinguish the later report in20:5.

records.native_phrase: Moi, maintenant, lié par l'Esprit, je vais à Jérusalem, sans savoir ce qui m'y arrivera,
